assessment.area: Production write admission and compatible reads
assessment.evidence: set_secret validates agent/platform/field before filesystem access. Its private read_for_write completes before create_dir_all, temporary-file write, or rename. Only ordinary NotFound admits an empty map. Valid JSON objects retain arbitrary other JSON values and the existing merge/pretty-newline/rename path. Empty, malformed, truncated, nonobject and invalid UTF-8 images, and non-NotFound I/O errors, return before any writer operation. Public read/get_secret behavior remains permissive and unchanged.

Read I/O errors are reconstructed with their ErrorKind and a fixed message; JSON failures become fixed InvalidData messages. Neither the original io::Error payload nor serde parser text/bytes is returned. Diagnostics carry only agentId and bounded I/O kind/JSON Category/NonObject classes. The tests inspect Display, Debug, propagated consumer messages, tray serialization and secret/path sentinels without printing raw rejected images.

CCWA-ORACLE-01 explicitly supersedes corrupt-to-empty-to-successful-overwrite as an intentional safety change. The revised existing test preserves permissive read and asserts refused overwrite plus exact old bytes. Explicit removal followed by a legitimate new write remains a positive control. Validation, normal merge, empty-secret, formatting and removal behavior are retained, so the repair is not achieved by deleting valid assertions.

The Unix test changes only its owned regular file to mode 000, proves the actual read returns PermissionDenied, and proves the parent remains writable with a sibling create/remove probe. Both the direct store and real Session refuse before replacement. Permissions are restored before subsequent result assertions and by a Drop guard on unwinding. A privileged runner that can still read fails the premise instead of reporting a false pass. This distinguishes checked admission from the old writable-parent overwrite path.

Real store_connector_credential runs through the existing per-agent filesystem lock and durable Agent admission. set_secret(...)? precedes open_channel_store/write_metadata. Tests materialize real Agents, preserve exact existing metadata and ensure missing metadata/directories remain absent, retain unrelated Agent/platform bytes, repeat refusal after Session shutdown/reopen, explicitly repair, and reopen again for successful readback. No second credential or metadata owner was introduced.

connectChannel maps the actual Session write error to Internal before listing successful results. The production main continuation emits channel-connected/disconnected timeline events only after the Session result is successfully unwrapped. The new direct gateway test covers invalid existing bytes with both metadata states, exact unrelated bytes, shutdown/reopen refusal, valid-object repair and ordinary disconnect. Returned errors and replies exclude the synthetic credentials.

Actual WidgetResponses::submit_secret invokes the Session credential writer with ? before the config callback, secretProvided mutation, persisted transcript update/roster projection or acknowledgement construction. Seven concrete malformed/I/O fixtures assert zero callback, no acknowledgement, unchanged transcript and roster events, exact target/unrelated bytes and no added directory entries. Repair reuses the same persisted request, retains other JSON fields, invokes one callback, commits/projections the provided flag, and returns a redacted acknowledgement. Duplicate submission is ignored. A fresh Session owner sees the committed result after disposal/shutdown.

The manager fixture binds actual Session, shared Memory, TranscriptManager, production service container and HostTraysExtension; only unused attachment ports panic. The Agent is activated before the negative baseline, so existing switch-agent effects are not incorrectly attributed to the write. Widget refusal enters the manager's real fixed tray branch and returns Ok(false), with no resume, callback, acknowledgement or persisted-entry change. Four refusals exercise real tray dedupe/count/events and bounded empty optional detail fields. Repair succeeds through the same manager/request, resumes once with the actual redacted acknowledgement, and a duplicate cannot resume or overwrite.

Source inspection connects manager.dispose to runtime/automation/workflow shutdown and Session shutdown_with_checkpoint, which drains/flushed owners and closes DB/pool handles. Tests perform these shutdowns before fresh Session construction. Memory extension Drop disposes its service; the false search gate prevents a real index worker/subscription from starting; search Drop unsubscribes/disposes, telemetry is explicitly disposed/flushed, and real tray subscriptions use Weak-backed Drop cleanup. The core reporter guard is reset and filtered to its unique fixture Agent. File-permission restoration is local and RAII-backed. No new lifetime or side-effect defect was found.
